intro: Krusk is an orc scout stationed at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Dispatched directly under Warchief Thrall's orders to investigate the Syndicate and recover relics from the ruins of Durnholde Keep, he now coordinates reconnaissance and rescue efforts after his initial infiltration was ambushed.

p: When Warchief Thrall turned his attention back to the ruins of Durnholde Keep, he dispatched Krusk and a small strike team to scout Syndicate activity and retrieve relics tied to the fortress's grim past. However, the human outlaws proved more entrenched and coordinated than anticipated. An ambush inside Durnholde's crumbling walls overwhelmed the orcish scout squad. Krusk managed to fight his way out, but his comrades were taken captive: Drull and Tog'thar were locked away within the ruins, while the expedition's leader, Gol'dir, was moved to another Syndicate hold. Regrouping at Tarren Mill, Krusk now directs Horde adventurers to breach Durnholde, recover the lost items, and liberate his trapped comrades.

Beyond recovering his scouts, Krusk remains fixated on dismantling the Syndicate's hold over Hillsbrad. The fallen nobles of Alterac represent a volatile threat, operating out of Durnholde Keep and scheming against both Horde outposts and their former Alliance brethren. Working from Tarren Mill, Krusk tracks the movements of Syndicate leaders, such as Lord Aliden Perenolde, hoping to sever their leadership before they can threaten the tenuous Horde foothold in Lordaeron.
